scheme: PINN, tanh MLP depth 4, inputs (cos x, sin x, t/T) for exact periodicity, hard IC u=u0+t*NN, residual-only loss, Adam then L-BFGS, torch 2.11.0+cu128 on cuda, float32
benchmark: 1D viscous Burgers, Cole-Hopf, nu=0.07, x in [0,2pi] periodic, t_end=0.5
grids_meaning: number of random collocation points N_c in [0,2pi]x[0,0.5]
error_norm: discrete L2: sqrt(dx*sum(err^2)) at t=0.5 on 2048 uniform points
size_abscissa: h = sqrt(2pi*0.5/N_c), mean collocation spacing; slope of log(err) vs log(h)
theoretical_order_note: none: PINN error is limited by optimization and network capacity; there is no a-priori rate in h
